{"type":"thought","data":"I have reviewed the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market data and am ready"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to place my bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe draw market is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly overpriced."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Models estimate a 25%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of a draw, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market offers 29.5%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" ScoutingStats notes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only a +0.3% edge. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The No side appears "}
{"type":"thought","data":"more attractive."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe math confirms "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the No side is +EV. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Betting No yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 4 tokens of expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value, while Yes loses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 13."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am weighing a contrarian"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on Yes. If the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"match draws, I would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win +233 while others"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lose -100. The downside"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is losing 100 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if it does not draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA contrarian bet on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes would lose roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 18 tokens in expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relative P&L if rivals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all pick No. The leaderboard"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie rule also means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that even a winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" contrarian bet cannot"}
{"type":"thought","data":" guarantee a unique "}
{"type":"thought","data":"top finish."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe prior record shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" small wins on favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and large losses on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdogs. The goal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is to maximize P&L,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the safer +EV side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the better choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA closer look at draw-market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history reveals a key"}
{"type":"thought","data":" flaw in the prior reasoning."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The record shows three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins and two losses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on draw-No bets, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the net result is negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because each loss costs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the full 100-token "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stake while the payouts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are small. This means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw markets are not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profitable overall "}
{"type":"thought","data":"despite the win-loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Cagliari draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet at 0.69 paid +44.9"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. The current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No price of 0.705 is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly higher than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that prior level, so"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the expected value "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of a draw bet is somewhat"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower than in that "}
{"type":"thought","data":"winning instance."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe two prior draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" losses likely came "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from evenly matched "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fixtures where a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was more probable. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Genoa versus Venezia"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a similar midtable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matchup, so the 29.5%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price for Yes looks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly rich."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmakers are the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharpest source of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"truth. The 29.5% price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches their no-vig"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw estimate, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" models cluster near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25%. A contrarian bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Yes would only be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profitable if the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability exceeded"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 30%. I will place a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No bet at the best "}
{"type":"thought","data":"ask plus 0.05."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will set the max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.73 to avoid a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bad fill if the book"}
{"type":"thought","data":" moves. I am drafting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a trash-talking quote"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about Venezia's lack"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of draws and the 30-cent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trap."}
